Class TailPlan

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Plan
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.TailPlan
All Implemented Interfaces:
Consenting, Sequence, Comparable<Plan>, Iterable<Action>
public class TailPlan extends Plan
A plan formed by prepending a single action to an existing plan (i.e. by adding a single action to the tail).
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
